messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — insurance evidence & PO flow

Hi Ellen —

Thanks for starting the onboarding conversation with us. To get procurement / AP setup completed so we can issue a PO and begin billing, can you please return the following items by EOD Monday (2026-08-31) if possible: 

- Certificate(s) of Insurance: General Liability (min $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate), Professional/E&O (min $1M), and Cyber/Privacy (min $1M). Please ensure the COI lists policy numbers, effective/expiry dates and insurer name.
- Make sure the certificate names the certificate holder as: "Redwood Inference, Inc., Attn: Procurement, 1350 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103"
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- W9 (or equivalent tax form)
- Remittance / AP contact and preferred invoice format (email for e-invoice, remit-to address)
- Bank details if you prefer ACH (we'll treat this as secure info via DocuSign if needed)

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

Once we have COI + W9 + onboarding form, AP will validate and we'll issue PO (target PO issuance: 2026-09-02). If any of the COI limits or wording will take longer to provide, please flag here.

If easier, you can upload originals to the Drive folder (link below) or send attachments directly to this thread.

Drive (for uploads): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_shared_onboarding

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Thanks for the checklist. Please find the initial documents attached: Vanguard_COI_GL_EO_Cyber_0829.pdf, W9_Vanguard_Inc.pdf and the completed onboarding form (Completed_Onboarding_Form.pdf). COI shows GL and E&O limits, and the cyber policy summary is included on page 2.

Let me know if you need anything else to get the PO out.

Thanks Ellen and team — quick procurement checks on the attached COI: 

- I see General Liability listed with policy period 2026-06-01 to 2027-06-01 and limits that meet our floor. Please confirm the insurer name and spell out the policy numbers (I couldn't read the scanned header clearly).
- For E&O: please confirm this is Professional Liability (not only CGL endorsement) and provide the policy number and retroactive date if available.
- Cyber: confirm whether the cyber policy includes third-party privacy breach coverage and whether there is a sublimit/retention noted.

If you can provide the certificate with the exact certificate holder wording below, that will speed validation: 
"Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Procurement
1350 Market St
San Francisco, CA 94103"

Ellen —

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the docs. A couple quick items AP needs before we can issue the PO (PO-2026-0842):

- Confirm legal entity to appear on the PO/invoice (Vanguard Data Systems, Inc.) and whether you invoice under a different DBA.
- Confirm remit-to email for e-invoicing and whether you accept ACH (if yes, we'll send a secure ACH form via DocuSign).
- If you can provide the insurer names & policy numbers in a short reply that would save AP time; otherwise we'll request a COI with the exact certificate holder wording and policy numbers visible.

We'll hold PO-2026-0842 in draft and expect to finalize it once AP validates the W9 and the COI wording. Expect email from procurements@redwoodinference.com when the PO is ready — target issuance 2026-09-02.

For your reference, attaching Redwood_COI_Instructions.pdf (shows the certificate wording we require).
